div.head: III Atr 3.3
div.ab: ⁊ ælc bicge him lage mid XII óran, healf landrican, healf wæpentake.
Et omnis emat sibi lagam duodecim oris, dimidium landesrico, dimidium wapentako.
⁊ ælc bicge him lage mid XII óran, healf landrican, healf wæpentake.
Und [deren] jeder kaufe sich Rechtsschutz mit 12 Ör, halb dem Immunitätsherrn, halb dem Wapentake.
And let each [of them] buy himself legal protection with 12 ores, half to the lord of the immunity, half to the wapentake.
And each of them shall pay 12 ores, half to the lord of the manor and half to the wapentake. in order to obtain the benefit of the law.
And each of them shall buy for himself [the benefit of the] law with twelve ores, half to the lord of the estate, half to the wapentake.

note.seg: Ebenso u. 8, 2¹. Der Betrag ist derselbe wie für lahslit (s. Rechtsbruchbusse), zu gering, um (wie vielleicht lahcop, o. 3⁴) Friedlosigkeit abzukaufen; nur den Nachteil der Bescholtenheit kauft er ab
Likewise below 8, 2¹. The amount is the same as for lahslit (see Rechtsbruchbusse), too small to buy off outlawry (as perhaps lahcop, above 3⁴ does); it buys off only the disadvantage of ill repute
The amount is the same as lahslit, cf. E. and G. 3, 2.
